name: scope-preview
title: Scope Preview
description: A calendar connection request where the permission list isn't the whole story: toggle any scope and a live preview panel recomputes what the connection could actually do, down to a genuine two-scope combination (read plus create) that unlocks a real "Add to calendar" action neither scope enables alone. Hover a scope and the exact preview line it powers highlights in place, so the abstract checkbox and the concrete consequence are never more than a glance apart.
